chunks: He (peace be upon him) said, and the news of the death of al-Ashtar had reached him, may Allah have mercy on him:

key_terms.الْأَشْتَرِ: Al-Ashtar (referring to Malik ibn al-Harith al-Ashtar)
key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on him

ai.seo_question: What happened when the news of al-Ashtar's death reached Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration marks a poignant moment in Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) receives the news of Malik al-Ashtar’s death, highlighting the deep personal bond and political significance of his most trusted governor. The event underscores the transient nature of worldly power and the Imam’s characteristic composure, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual and temporal leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt amidst the trials of the early Caliphate.
